title: Joint IETF 127 vector set with Haven (Jason's ask #3)
description:
Promised in #mimi 238131: draft a vector set from the weekend's tests, post it for Jason to check before either repo commits it; each side commits it to its own repo (no PRs on havenmessenger repos).

Format: Haven's protocol07-vectors.json schema (format_version 1; vectors of {id, kind, description, hex, decode}) so both replay tests can read it, plus per-vector expected outcomes where a hub decides: 'spec' (what the drafts say or our proposal), 'mimid', 'haven' (accept/refuse, with the reason), so known differences are data, not test failures.

Slice 1, wire-level, no MLS group: consent request and cancel (henry -> alice, any room); AbuseReport metadata-only and with a zero-frank AbusiveMessage; UpdateRoomResponse wrongEpoch; identifierQuery handle in RFC 3986-equivalent forms (uppercase scheme/host, hex case, %61); RoleData with role_name of 1024 and 1025 octets and with invalid UTF-8; IdentifierUri with non-ASCII host; MimiContent carrying a few naughty strings and NFC/NFD pairs. Later slices: the MLS bundles (Add + roles_list refused, stale-epoch Commit, Add + base_room_policy accepted).
